facts.fact: Aristides Marques, national director of Identification, Registries and Notary, says a death registered through the conservatoria services is sent to the database to deregister (give baixa to) the citizen, which needs the deceased's BI to be reliable.

AGO.note: No count or share of people holding the ID is given.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is named.
Nothing on issuance, biometrics or certification.
The text does not say whether local offices enter deaths digitally at registration.
